scope.summary: Make the cloud-only CI repair path authenticate safely, repair only eligible failing Node tests, and align Phase 2 and evidence reconciliation with the current Development required checks.
implemented: Added exact failed-npm-test-step eligibility, a first-attempt tokenless auth smoke, bounded configurable retries, a 12-hour parking signal, and existing stale-HEAD/no-force safeguards.
Reruns Verify and database-smoke after a repair and aligns Phase 2 and current evidence reconciliation with verify plus database-smoke.
Preserved legacy database workflow coverage, nightly regression, squash-only native auto-merge, and GitHub's review/conversation gates.

decisions: Use official tokenless Copilot CLI authentication with the Actions GITHUB_TOKEN and copilot-requests: write; make no authentication success claim until the exact job smoke passes.
Repair only same-repository open Development PRs whose failed Verify job stopped at npm test, with current-head validation and no force update.
Require current verify and database-smoke results for Phase 2 and new evidence; retain legacy database evidence only for historical runs without the smoke check.
Keep PR #286 draft and the parent issue open; do not alter branch protection or initiate production, database, external integration, or deployment work.
limitations: The live Development ruleset approval and conversation-resolution settings were not available from the GitHub read surfaces used here.
